verdict.rationale: FutureHouse ships an official Python client (edison-client) with documented install, auth, task submission, chat sessions, and file management APIs across a dedicated SDK docs section, indicating a real official SDK for building agentic workflows against Kosmos/Literature/Analysis/Precedent/Molecules agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration outside vendor docs, and a working OpenAPI/spec reference (probe shows 404s for OpenAPI endpoints).
